sentences.en: We chose Father as a neutral judge of our disputes.
sentences.zh: 我们选父亲作为纠纷的中立裁判。

sentences.en: A neutral country was asked to help settle the dispute.
sentences.zh: 请一个中立国家来帮忙解决争端。

sentences.en: The Japanese government takes a neutral attitude on the matter.
sentences.zh: 日本政府对此事采取中立态度。

senses.zh: 中立的，中性的；中立国的；非彩色的
